title: 第2167章 贪污者之多第2166章 务要再现费恩之事
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：领主：从开拓骑士开始第一卷：默认第2167章贪污者之多（..la）《祈星西区与祈星东区临时官制现行条例》，这份文件是贝尔德在光辉历9807年年初递交上来的，自己做了批注后就全权交给贝尔德去负责了。
按照临时官制条例规定，祈星西区与祈星东区设立官署，任命一名特级执政官，全权负责管辖区域内各行省政务。
行省内，设立总督府，由各兵团推举人员担任行省总督，并由兵团派遣人员对总督进行监督，政务方面向官署负责，税务方面归祈星郡后勤部负责，三方交叉，以保证对区域控制。
相比之下，郡这一级就宽松了很多，采用了四套班子。
以执政官为核心建立行政体系，保证民生稳定，有效征收税务，对地区埃兰人的教化以及辅助教会传教等各种事务。
以治安官为核心建立治安体系，辅助执政官稳定治安，抓捕罪犯，调解冒险者纠纷等事务。
以卫城将军为核心建立民兵制度与城防军防务体系，搭建基层兵役制度，保证稳定的兵源，在前线军队出现重大损失后，能快速补充兵力。
以驻军将军建立常备军，防止地方叛乱。
而到了县这一级，行政架构与郡相似。
至于县下面的镇，采取是行政权力暂时归于地方，但兵权向上收拢的政策。
这套制度在当时很不错，但是随着大的环境趋于稳定，地方新的政治生态成型，叛乱势力销声匿迹后，这套制度也要开始改变了。
不过突然改变官制肯定也不行，还需要慢慢来，如此才不会引起大的混乱。
除此之外，关于官员制度的设立，也需要召开一场会议进行讨论，集众人的智慧将新的体系搭建起来，之后再查漏补缺，慢慢完善。
“这件事拖不得，最迟明年七月份就要召开一次会议。”
在他的计划中，等赛拉菲塔音王国向祈星军完成移交国土后的第三年的祈星日，就是他建国的时候。
中间这一年多的时间，他需要完成战功的评定，选定那些行省用作贵族封地，那些行省用作王室直辖行省，那些行省成为公爵领。
而要评定战功，就需要去核算军中立下大功的将军。
幸好有凯尔在，不然让他去处理这些事情的话，那晒太阳的时间几乎就没有了。
……
光辉历9813年8月15日，奥克拉城北城区一座院落内，布伦德坐在矮桌旁看着奥克拉城的日报。

“拉普恩庄园以六十万金币被风行者商会购入，创每亩单价十万金币历史新高！”
“生命教会第七牧师学院宣布招生八百人，光辉历9月1日截止报名！”
“特莱亚行省里迪安城执政官费恩自裁于王宫，以死谢罪！”
“特莱亚行省里迪安城治安局局长温斯顿·科马克被斩首，据称其家属被连坐。”
“……”
看着第三个标题，布伦德的手不由得颤抖了起来。
扫视日报，很快便找到了对应的内容。
文字不多，仅有三百多个字，但却将整件事完整的讲述了出来。
“好。”
“好。”
“好！”
“哈哈哈，死了，这个家伙终于死了。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Lord: Starting from the Pioneer Knights Volume 1: Default Chapter 2167 The Many Corruptors (..la) "Current Regulations of the Provisional Official System of Qixing West District and Qixing East District". This document was submitted by Baird at the beginning of 9807 in the Glorious Calendar. After he made an annotation, Baird was fully responsible for it.
In accordance with the provisions of the provisional official system regulations, Qixing West District and Qixing East District established official offices and appointed a special consul to be fully responsible for the government affairs of each province within their jurisdiction.
Within the province, a governor-general's office is established, and each corps elects personnel to serve as the provincial governor. The corps dispatches personnel to supervise the governor. Government affairs are responsible to the government office, and taxation is the responsibility of the Qixing County Logistics Department. The three parties intersect to ensure regional control.
In contrast, the county level is much more relaxed and adopts four sets of teams.
Establish an administrative system with the consul as the core to ensure the stability of people's livelihood, effectively collect taxes, educate the Elamite people in the region, and assist the church in preaching and other matters.
Establish a public security system with the Sheriff as the core, assisting the Archon in stabilizing public order, arresting criminals, mediating disputes between adventurers and other matters.
Establish a militia system and a city defense force defense system with the Acropolis General as the core, and establish a grassroots military service system to ensure a stable source of troops and quickly replenish troops after heavy losses to the frontline troops.
Establish a standing army with garrison generals to prevent local rebellions.
At the county level, the administrative structure is similar to that of a county.
As for the towns below the county level, a policy was adopted in which administrative power was temporarily transferred to the local governments, but military power was drawn upwards.
This system was very good at the time, but as the general environment stabilizes, a new local political ecology takes shape, and the rebel forces disappear, this system will begin to change.
However, it is definitely not possible to change the official system suddenly. It needs to be done slowly, so as not to cause big chaos.
In addition, regarding the establishment of the official system, it is also necessary to hold a meeting to discuss and pool the wisdom of everyone to build a new system, and then check for omissions and fill in the gaps, and slowly improve it.
"This matter cannot be delayed. A meeting will be held in July next year at the latest."
In his plan, he would establish the kingdom on the third year after the Kingdom of Serafitayin completed the transfer of territory to the Star Prayer Army on the Prayer Day.
In the intervening period of more than a year, he needed to complete the assessment of military merit and select which provinces would be used as noble fiefs, which provinces would be used as provinces directly under the royal family, and which provinces would become duchies.
To evaluate military merit, we need to count the generals who have made great contributions to the military.
Fortunately, Kyle was here, otherwise if he had to deal with these things, there would be almost no time to bask in the sun.
…
On August 15, 9813 in the Glorious Calendar, in a courtyard in the northern district of Okla City, Brende sat at a low table and read the daily newspaper of Okla City.
"Lapuen Manor was purchased by the Windrunner Chamber of Commerce for 600,000 gold coins, setting a record high unit price of 100,000 gold coins per acre!"
“The Seventh Pastoral College of Life Church announced the enrollment of 800 students, and the deadline for registration is September 1st of the glorious calendar!”
"Finn, the consul of Lidian City in the province of Trea, committed suicide in the palace and died to apologize!"
"Winston Cormac, the chief of the security bureau of Lydian City in Trea Province, was beheaded, and his family members were allegedly imprisoned."
"..."
Looking at the third title, Brender's hands couldn't help but tremble.
Scanning the daily newspaper, I quickly found the corresponding content.
There is not much text, only more than 300 words, but it tells the whole story completely.
"Okay."
"Okay."
"Okay!"
"Hahaha, dead, this guy is finally dead."
